name: Tm Process Mining
pitch: Build a canonical process model at reload and explore it with nine Qlik Cloud extensions.
question: Which Activities and Transitions shape each Process?
useWhen: Compare Cases, Variants, and Transitions in a Process.
features: Map Activities and Transitions with Process Map.
Compare Variant sequences with Variant Braids.
Group Cases into Lines by value or Object type with Tube Map.
Trace Events across Cases with Case Timeline and Journey Stripes.
Compare two Populations with Lifecycle and Difference Map.
Inspect Rework and Transition frequency with Rework Map and Process Matrix.
